fact: The SRC says from January 2024 taxpayers are to pay by bank transfer or at SRC offices, sending the payment slip, return form and proof of payment by email.
The SRC says it has started migrating to a new online tax platform, with payment advise numbers to be activated when the new tax portal goes live.

The WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement database record, from Seychelles' extension request, lists an electronic payment (E-Payment) module among the completed additions to the Seychelles Revenue Commission's ASYCUDA World customs system.
